configuration.incontrol.telemetryEnabled: Anonymous usage data is not sent anywhere by this build - there is no upstream hub to receive it. Leave this off unless you run your own incontrol Hub and point `serverSettings.telemetryUri` at it.

configuration.incontrol.enableQuickActio: Enable the experimental Quick Actions feature. configuration.incontrol.enableNextEdit: Enable incontrol's next edit feature. Read our docs to learn about configuration and how to share feedback: [continue.dev › Features › Autocomplete › Next Edit (experimental)](https://docs.continue.dev/features/autocomplete/next-edit)
configuration.incontrol.pauseTabAutocomp: Pause incontrol's tab autocomplete feature when your battery is low.
